name: pytest
summary: Contributions made with AI tools are welcome as long as the submitter understands the changes, can respond to review and takes responsibility. Purely agentic PRs without meaningful human review are closed and their authors banned. Crediting AI with Co-authored-by is appreciated but optional.

evidence.quote: We welcome contributions from all developers, including those who use AI/LLM tools as part of their workflow.
Regardless of how the code was produced, the person submitting a pull request must understand the changes and be able to respond to review feedback.
Pull requests that are entirely generated by AI agents, with no meaningful human review, understanding, or oversight, will be closed.
This is not required, but helps reviewers set expectations and is appreciated.
